name: Microgrid restoration protection-ready gate
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Requires the assigned protection configuration to be available for the intended restoration topology.
description: Requires the assigned protection configuration to be available for the intended restoration topology. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Protection mode and health” at the input and “Restoration protection permission” at the output. Protection availability must cover the actual energized sections.
